name: UserMenu
description: The account menu: an avatar button that opens a DropdownMenu with the person's identity, a workspace switcher, a theme control, your items and Log out, which always comes last. Composed from Avatar and DropdownMenu, on the same menu machine.

livewire.name: user-menu
capabilities: Children: dropdown-menu-item, dropdown-menu-group and dropdown-menu-separator, after items
profile stays as a deprecated alias
logoutAction posts the log out item to a URL with the CSRF token

react.name: UserMenu
capabilities: Children: DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuGroup and DropdownMenuSeparator, after items

vue.name: UserMenu
capabilities: Children: DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuGroup and DropdownMenuSeparator, after items

props.name: user
props.description: Who is signed in: { name, email, avatar, role, status }. avatar is an image URL; role is the line under the name in the trigger, such as "Admin · Apexify"; status is online, away or offline.

props.name: workspaces
props.description: Workspaces to switch between: { id, name }. Two or more render a Workspace group of radio items.

props.name: workspace
props.description: The current workspace's id, checked in the group.

props.name: hideTheme
props.description: Hides the theme control (light, dark and system radio items), for apps with one theme.

props.name: theme
props.description: The checked theme. Setting the theme on the page stays yours, on theme-change.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu items between the theme control and Log out, as DropdownMenu items data: { value, label, icon, shortcut, disabled }, separators and groups.

props.name: compact
props.description: Shows only the avatar in the trigger, for a top bar. The trigger keeps the name as its accessible name.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is open. Emitted as data-state on its parts.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled menu.

props.name: align
props.description: Which of the menu's edges lines up with the trigger's. Logical: follows the text direction.

props.name: surface
props.description: The menu's surface. Emitted as data-surface.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the menu at the end of the body. Off renders it in place.

props.name: workspaceLabel
props.description: The workspace group's label. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Workspace' ).

props.name: themeLabel
props.description: The theme group's label. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Theme' ).

props.name: themeLabels
props.description: The theme options' names, read by screen readers: { light, dark, system }. Translate them: Livewire defaults them through __().

props.name: logoutLabel
props.description: The last item's label. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Log out' ).

props.name: logoutAction
props.description: A URL the Log out item posts to, with the CSRF token, such as route( 'logout' ). Without it, Log out reports select with the value logout.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, the menu's included, such as { trigger: '…', item: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The menu panel: .apui-dropdown-menu.apui-user-menu, the machine's content part.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The avatar button that opens the menu.

parts.name: avatar
parts.description: The Avatar, in the trigger and in the header.

parts.name: identity
parts.description: The name and the role or email, beside an avatar.

parts.name: role
parts.description: The line under the name in the trigger.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: The up-down chevron at the end of the trigger.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The identity at the top of the menu: avatar, name and email.

parts.name: themeOptions
parts.description: The light, dark and system radio items, as a segmented row.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Replaces the trigger's content (avatar, name and role).

events.name: open-change
events.description: The menu opened or closed itself.

events.name: select
events.description: An item was chosen, by click or Enter. The payload is its value; Log out reports logout.

events.name: workspace-change
events.description: A workspace was chosen. The payload is its id; checking it stays yours, through workspace.

events.name: theme-change
events.description: A theme was chosen. The payload is light, dark or system; applying it stays yours.

keyboard.action: On the trigger, opens the menu on the first item.
Move through the items, the workspace and theme options included.
Chooses the item; a workspace or theme option is checked.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

requirements: The trigger is a button with aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded and the person's name as its accessible name, also when compact.
Workspace and theme options are menuitemradio in labelled groups, with aria-checked.
The theme options show icons; their names stay in the accessibility tree.
Log out is always the last item, after a separator.
The avatars inside are decorative: the trigger and the header already say the name.
Everything DropdownMenu requires: focus moves in on open and back to the trigger on close, stable ids in Livewire.
